problems:
# Latvia (LVA) - sub-national homicide

## Used
Iekšlietu ministrijas Informācijas centrs (IeM IC), "Kriminālā statistika", one file per year 2005-2025 (https://www.ic.iem.gov.lv/lv/kriminala-statistika). These are the police-registered criminal offences (data from the Kriminālprocesa informācijas sistēma). 

- 2013-2025: every article/point column of KL art. 116-124 by city and municipality (novads), plus country, city/municipality subtotals ('Kopā (section)') and "address not given". The 2021 reform changed municipalities: 2021 is published as two files (01.01-19.08 old division; 20.08-31.12 new division); both are kept with year 2021 and the period in the note. Do not add the two 2021 parts per municipality across the boundary change without checking names.
- 2012: by statistical region and municipality.
- 2011: by investigating institution / State Police regional directorate (pārvalde) and precinct (iecirknis), not by municipality. Blank cells are kept blank as published.
- 2005-2010: PDFs, only the column "Tīšas slepkavības 116.-118.p." and its sub-column "Sadzīves iemesli" (domestic motives) were extracted. 2005-2009 areas are cities and the old rajoni (districts), plus "pilsētā un rajonā" combined rows (which overlap the separate city and district rows - do not double count). The PDF tables also have assault, robbery, theft etc. columns, not extracted.

## Caveats
- Measures: the CSB calls KL 116-118 "Tīšas slepkavības" (intentional homicides). Art. 119-124 columns are in the 2011-2025 data as published; their offence names are not given in the files (only article numbers), so I have not labelled them.
- 117.p.N.pkt. columns are sub-points of 117.p.; 118.p.N.pkt. sub-points of 118.p.; do not add them to the article totals.
- 2007 PDF: two labels were garbled in the text layer ("Liepājas pilsētā", "Valkas rajonā"); their values sat on a continuation line and were attached to the clean name (noted in the row). After that, 2007 city rows sum to 22 vs published 24 and rural rows to 52 vs 53, so one or two 2007 values may be misread; the other PDF years add up exactly.
- No licence statement on ic.iem.gov.lv; the publisher's municipal totals on data.gov.lv are CC0 1.0.

## Checked, not usable
- CSB (data.stat.gov.lv) NOR010: homicide national only; NOR023: municipality totals by severity only; archive (OSP_OD) has only convictions.
- Valsts policija site not needed (IeM IC is the official registrar).
